text: Assumption: Read and write accesses to variables of type sint8 are atomic on typical microcontroller architectures — is this correct?

assumption: Read and write accesses to variables of type sint8 are atomic on typical microcontroller architectures.
rationale: sint8 maps a single 8-bit byte, even though SWS_Platform_00016 makes no statements regarding hardware architectures or concurrency.
